svg.title: M03: one shared run, distinct actions, attempts and actual executions
svg.desc: The incident is a business record. The investigation run spans the customer, IT and network agents. One IT action has separate original and retry attempts. Actual provider executions are reconciled separately, and several observations may describe the same execution.
svg.text: M03 · Same investigation. Different kinds of identity.
Synthetic example · identities and source mappings are proposed contracts, not verified workshop payloads

g.title: Ticket INC-001 may reference more than one authorized investigation episode
One trusted run identity and pinned policy follow work across the three zones
g.text: Trusted team + root run + pinned policy version
A new episode needs a declared reason; an agent cannot reset the cap by renaming it.

g.title: The ticket references this investigation; it does not define its run identity

svg.text: ALL THREE AGENTS KEEP RUN FM-001 — EACH OWNS DISTINCT ACTIONS

g.title: Customer zone actor and action within FM-001
IT zone actor and action within the same FM-001
Network zone actor and distinct action within FM-001
Gateway A carries supported trusted context and shared handoff identity
Gateway B carries the same root run and a distinct handoff identity
The logical intended operation persists across genuine retries
Original attempt can remain uncertain after a lost response
A deliberate new execution has its own admission and retains parent attempt relationship
One action references both attempted executions
Provider execution can be discovered after its response was lost
A second actual provider execution is separately accounted
These source-corroborated links are not inferred from timestamps
Multiple source observations corroborate one charge; extra actual executions must still be counted
g.text: Gateway event + collector span + usage export can describe the same P-091.
Keep all source assertions; count one authoritative execution charge. A hidden extra execution is another charge, not a duplicate log.

svg.text: An attempt may have zero executions (denied), one, or several exposed by hidden retries. Preserve the actual source evidence.
Ticket / trace / timestamp similarity is not proof. Missing or conflicting identity remains a disclosed reconciliation gap.
